US Envoy Sergio Gor Discusses India-US Ties and Business Expansion

US Ambassador to India Sergio Gor met with Amazon executives in Bengaluru to discuss expanding the company's footprint in India and strengthening bilateral economic ties. Gor also met with Indian astronaut Shubhanshu Shukla, highlighting the expanding India-US partnership, particularly in space cooperation. He outlined a vision for US-India relations and unveiled the TRUST Fellowship in Bengaluru, emphasizing a focus on delivering practical outcomes and creating win-win opportunities for both nations.
